verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware security keys with companion management tools (SK Manager, iePassManager, OTP Tool), so a vendor-published MCP server for agent integration is a plausible, applicable axis. Nothing in the evidence documents an official MCP server or any agent-facing interface, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
